provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: run captures profile, byte-preserving command/version results, timing and before/after snapshots, retaining failures. Execution::validate reconstructs hashes and required membership including runner/configuration; snapshot rejects symlinks and records empty directories with the listed exclusions. status selects latest finish times and lets tied failure/staleness block success. The named tests cover failure paths, tampering, ties, changes and offline status. The prose explicitly excludes authentication, hermeticity and restored-between-snapshot edits, which the implementation cannot detect.
limitations: This is a source-level comparison of the retained authored unit, exact cited declarations/tests and policy. It is not proof of exhaustive implementation behavior, a browser rendering test or a claim that every conservative context file was read. The reviewer authored the new audit integration/tests, then performed this separate comparison pass; no independence from that implementation is claimed.
